title: Balan arrives late (new beat before SB022)
subtitle: Cochin harbour, mid-morning · light-hearted · four shots, 8 s each · Ranjith, 2026-11-10

panels.title: Balan hurries up the gangplank
beats: Same quay view as s13-sh03 (uru LEFT, warehouses RIGHT).
0–2 s Balan out from between the warehouses, walking quickly, smoothing his hair.
2–5 s up the gangplank with an easy smile; 5–8 s onto the deck by the deckhouse.

panels.title: Aashaan teases him (Rinoy)
beats: Same set-up and frame as s13-sh04 (shown).
He straightens, hands on hips, eyes on Balan just RIGHT of the lens.
2.5–5.5 s the teasing line; then shakes his head, back to the lashing.

panels.title: Balan's easy reply (Brad)
beats: Camera beside Aashaan looking forward; quay and warehouses beyond the rail at the LEFT.
2.5–5 s the reply, eyes on Aashaan just RIGHT of the lens.
Then a shrug, a silent chuckle, a glance toward the bow.

panels.title: Antony smiles at the bow
beats: Same as s13-sh05 (start from its last frame).
He hears them, looks back just LEFT of the lens, smiles, shakes his head.
Back to the rope. Next: s13-sh06, the uru leaves.

panels.title: 3D blocking: who stands where
beats: Quay on the uru's left side; gangplank by the deckhouse; Aashaan at the sacks by the mast; Antony at the bow.
